description: SEO Monitoring Dashboard - Site auditing and performance monitoring using Lighthouse and CrUX APIs

testingSetup.important: Dev server MUST run on localhost:3000 - Supabase auth is configured for this URL only

userStories.title: Create SEO database schema
userStories.description: As a developer, I need database tables to store SEO configuration and audit results.
acceptanceCriteria: Create seo_configs table with: id, project_id, studio_id, domain, is_enabled, client_visible_metrics (JSONB), created_at, updated_at
Create seo_audits table with: id, project_id, studio_id, audit_type ('lighthouse' | 'crux'), scores (JSONB), raw_data (JSONB), audited_at, created_at
Add RLS policies: studios can only access their own SEO data
Add foreign key constraints to projects table with ON DELETE CASCADE
Create index on (project_id, audited_at DESC) for efficient time-series queries
Add UNIQUE constraint on seo_configs(project_id)
Migration runs successfully
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Completed. Created migration 20260110100000_create_seo_tables.sql with seo_configs and seo_audits tables. RLS policies for studio and client access. Triggers to auto-set studio_id from project. Indexes for efficient queries including (project_id, audited_at DESC). UNIQUE constraint on seo_configs(project_id).

userStories.notes: Completed. Created libs/seo/crux.ts with getCoreWebVitals(domain) function. Calls Chrome UX Report API at chromeuxreport.googleapis.com/v1/records:queryRecord. Extracts LCP, INP (replaces FID), CLS metrics with p75 percentile values. Returns threshold status (good/needs-improvement/poor) based on Google's Core Web Vitals thresholds.
